x: The Mawlid method of Grandshaykh ʿAbdullāh al-Fāʾiz ad-Dāghestānī — the first quarter of the Qaṣīda Hamziyya of Imām al-Būṣīrī
Mawlānā Shaykh Adnan at-Ṭāhir relates that it holds the whole of the Mawlid, is full of secrets, and is read in the Dīwān of Rasūlullāh ﷺ.
إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
Inna llāha wa malāʾikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā n-nabiyy — yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wa sallimū taslīmā.
Truly Allāh and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, invoke blessings upon him and greet him with peace.
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ كَمَالِ اللهِ وَكَمَا يَلِيقُ بِكَمَالِهِ
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi ʿadada kamāli llāhi wa kamā yalīqu bi-kamālih.
O Allāh, bless our master Muḥammad and his family, and grant them peace and grace, by the number of the perfection of Allāh and as befits His perfection.
The first quarter of the Hamziyya — twenty-three verses.
كَيْفَ تَرْقَى رُقِيَّكَ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ ✽ يَا سَمَاءً مَا طَاوَلَتْهَا سَمَاءُ
Kayfa tarqā ruqiyyaka l-anbiyāʾu ✽ yā samāʾan mā ṭāwalathā samāʾu
How should the prophets climb to your ascent — O heaven that no heaven has ever risen to match?
لَمْ يُسَاوُوكَ فِي عُلَاكَ وَقَدْ حَالَ ✽ سَنًى مِنْكَ دُونَهُمْ وَسَنَاءُ
Lam yusāwūka fī ʿulāka wa-qad ḥāla ✽ sanan minka dūnahum wa-sanāʾu
They did not equal you in your loftiness: a radiance from you, and a splendour, came between them and it.
إِنَّمَا مَثَّلُوا صِفَاتِكَ لِلنَّاسِ ✽ كَمَا مَثَّلَ النُّجُومَ الْمَاءُ
Innamā maththalū ṣifātika li-n-nāsi ✽ kamā maththala n-nujūma l-māʾu
They only figured your qualities to the people as water gives back the figure of the stars.
أَنْتَ مِصْبَاحُ كُلِّ فَضْلٍ فَمَا تَصْـ ✽ ـدُرُ إِلَّا عَنْ ضَوْئِكَ الْأَضْوَاءُ
Anta miṣbāḥu kulli faḍlin fa-mā taṣ ✽ duru illā ʿan ḍawʾika l-aḍwāʾu
You are the lamp of every excellence; no lights issue save from your light.
لَكَ ذَاتُ الْعُلُومِ مِنْ عَالِمِ الْغَيْـ ✽ ـبِ وَمِنْهَا لِآدَمَ الْأَسْمَاءُ
Laka dhātu l-ʿulūmi min ʿālimi l-ghay ✽ bi wa-minhā li-Ādama l-asmāʾu
Yours is the very substance of the sciences, from the Knower of the unseen; and from them came the Names to Ādam.
لَمْ تَزَلْ فِي ضَمَائِرِ الْكَوْنِ تُخْتَا ✽ ـرُ لَكَ الْأُمَّهَاتُ وَالْآبَاءُ
Lam tazal fī ḍamāʾiri l-kawni tukhtā ✽ ru laka l-ummahātu wa-l-ābāʾu
Ever, in the hidden depths of creation, were mothers and fathers being chosen for you.
مَا مَضَتْ فَتْرَةٌ مِنَ الرُّسْلِ إِلَّا ✽ بَشَّرَتْ قَوْمَهَا بِكَ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ
Mā maḍat fatratun mina r-rusli illā ✽ bashsharat qawmahā bika l-anbiyāʾu
No interval between messengers passed but the prophets gave their people good tidings of you.
تَتَبَاهَى بِكَ الْعُصُورُ وَتَسْمُو ✽ بِكَ عَلْيَاءُ بَعْدَهَا عَلْيَاءُ
Tatabāhā bika l-ʿuṣūru wa-tasmū ✽ bika ʿalyāʾu baʿdahā ʿalyāʾu
The ages glory in you, and by you height rises after height.
وَبَدَا لِلْوُجُودِ مِنْكَ كَرِيمٌ ✽ مِنْ كَرِيمٍ آبَاؤُهُ كُرَمَاءُ
Wa-badā li-l-wujūdi minka karīmun ✽ min karīmin ābāʾuhu kuramāʾu
And there appeared to existence, from you, a noble one from a noble one, whose forefathers were noble.
نَسَبٌ تَحْسِبُ الْعُلَا بِحُلَاهُ ✽ قَلَّدَتْهَا نُجُومَهَا الْجَوْزَاءُ
Nasabun taḥsibu l-ʿulā bi-ḥulāhu ✽ qalladathā nujūmahā l-Jawzāʾu
A lineage whose ornaments make you think the heights had been hung with them, as Orion hung its stars.
حَبَّذَا عِقْدُ سُؤْدَدٍ وَفَخَارٍ ✽ أَنْتَ فِيهِ الْيَتِيمَةُ الْعَصْمَاءُ
Ḥabbadhā ʿiqdu suʾdadin wa-fakhārin ✽ anta fīhi l-yatīmatu l-ʿaṣmāʾu
How fine a necklace of sovereignty and glory, in which you are the peerless solitary pearl.
مَوْلِدٌ كَانَ مِنْهُ فِي طَالِعِ الْكُفْـ ✽ ـرِ وَبَالٌ عَلَيْهِمُ وَوَبَاءُ
Mawlidun kāna minhu fī ṭāliʿi l-kuf ✽ ri wabālun ʿalayhimu wa-wabāʾu
A birth which was, in the ascendant of disbelief, a ruin upon them and a plague.
فَهَنِيئًا بِهِ لِآمِنَةَ الْفَضْـ ✽ ـلُ الَّذِي شُرِّفَتْ بِهِ حَوَّاءُ
Fa-hanīʾan bihi li-Āminata l-faḍ ✽ lu lladhī shurrifat bihi Ḥawwāʾu
So joy to Āmina in him — the honour by which Ḥawwāʾ herself was ennobled.
مَنْ لِحَوَّاءَ أَنَّهَا حَمَلَتْ أَحْـ ✽ ـمَدَ أَوْ أَنَّهَا بِهِ نُفَسَاءُ
Man li-Ḥawwāʾa annahā ḥamalat Aḥ ✽ mada aw annahā bihi nufasāʾu
Who could have granted Ḥawwāʾ that she should bear Aḥmad, or be delivered of him?
يَوْمَ نَالَتْ بِوَضْعِهِ ابْنَةُ وَهْبٍ ✽ مِنْ فَخَارٍ مَا لَمْ تَنَلْهُ النِّسَاءُ
Yawma nālat bi-waḍʿihi bnatu Wahbin ✽ min fakhārin mā lam tanalhu n-nisāʾu
The day the daughter of Wahb attained, by bearing him, a glory no woman has attained.
وَأَتَتْ قَوْمَهَا بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا ✽ حَمَلَتْ قَبْلُ مَرْيَمُ الْعَذْرَاءُ
Wa-atat qawmahā bi-afḍala mimmā ✽ ḥamalat qablu Maryamu l-ʿadhrāʾu
And she came to her people with better than what Maryam the Virgin had borne before.
شَمَّتَتْهُ الْأَمْلَاكُ إِذْ وَضَعَتْهُ ✽ وَشَفَتْنَا بِقَوْلِهَا الشَّفَّاءُ
Shammatathu l-amlāku idh waḍaʿathu ✽ wa-shafatnā bi-qawlihā sh-shaffāʾu
The angels greeted him when she bore him, and her healing word healed us.
رَافِعًا رَأْسَهُ وَفِي ذَلِكَ الرَّفْـ ✽ ـعِ إِلَى كُلِّ سُؤْدَدٍ إِيمَاءُ
Rāfiʿan raʾsahu wa-fī dhālika r-raf ✽ ʿi ilā kulli suʾdadin īmāʾu
Raising his head — and in that raising is a sign toward every sovereignty.
رَامِقًا طَرْفُهُ السَّمَاءَ وَمَرْمَى ✽ عَيْنِ مَنْ شَأْنُهُ الْعُلُوُّ الْعَلَاءُ
Rāmiqan ṭarfuhu s-samāʾa wa-marmā ✽ ʿayni man shaʾnuhu l-ʿuluwwu l-ʿalāʾu
His gaze fixed on the sky — and the target of the eye of one whose station is loftiness is the heights.
وَتَدَلَّتْ زُهْرُ النُّجُومِ إِلَيْهِ ✽ فَأَضَاءَتْ بِضَوْئِهَا الْأَرْجَاءُ
Wa-tadallat zuhru n-nujūmi ilayhi ✽ fa-aḍāʾat bi-ḍawʾihā l-arjāʾu
And the bright stars leaned down toward him, and the far quarters were lit by their light.
وَمُحَيًّا كَالشَّمْسِ مِنْكَ مُضِيءٌ ✽ أَسْفَرَتْ عَنْهُ لَيْلَةٌ غَرَّاءُ
Wa-muḥayyan ka-sh-shamsi minka muḍīʾun ✽ asfarat ʿanhu laylatun gharrāʾu
And a countenance from you, shining like the sun, which a radiant night disclosed.
لَيْلَةُ الْمَوْلِدِ الَّذِي كَانَ لِلدِّيـ ✽ ـنِ سُرُورٌ بِيَوْمِهِ وَازْدِهَاءُ
Laylatu l-mawlidi lladhī kāna li-d-dī ✽ ni surūrun bi-yawmihi wa-zdihāʾu
The night of the birth, which for the religion was joy and splendour on its day.
وَتَوَالَتْ بُشْرَى الْهَوَاتِفِ أَنْ قَدْ ✽ وُلِدَ الْمُصْطَفَى وَحَقَّ الْهَنَاءُ
Wa-tawālat bushrā l-hawātifi an qad ✽ wulida l-Muṣṭafā wa-ḥaqqa l-hanāʾu
And the glad tidings of unseen voices followed one on another: the Chosen One is born, and joy is due.
Then stand in qiyām, honouring Rasūlullāh ﷺ:
As-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʿalayka yā Rasūla llāh
Blessing and peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allāh
As-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʿalayka yā Ḥabība llāh
Blessing and peace be upon you, O Beloved of Allāh
As-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu ʿalayka yā man arsala llāhu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn
Blessing and peace be upon you, O you whom Allāh sent as a mercy to the worlds
Then read one hundred ṣalawāt standing, seeking blessing from Rasūlullāh ﷺ, and finish with the ihdāʾ.
